title: PG-10.1 Evidence, knowledge status and receipts (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP10 in memev: Evidence, knowledge status and receipts. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP10.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP04-01, WP07-02. Depends on contracts: SO-2.03, PG-06.1. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.03: WP10-01 and WP10-02 hold the knowledge status lattice and the origin fields; SO-2.03 holds retention, deletion, invalidation and derived-record provenance, and this spec takes none of them. Boundary with SO-2.01: WP10 defines the status of a fact, not the organisational model. Build layer (owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the signed fold contracts SO-F-09 (cited by id; delivered by pull request #341, WBS.md section 9.2 on its branch) are the build layer. Each task below that overlaps them cites the fold id and keeps only what the fold does not cover. Tasks of this spec that name no fold contract have no fold overlap. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
